title: Toast covers the consent banner's interactive buttons in the documented 320x480 corner, violating the frozen 'never cover its interactive (button) area' constraint
evidence: Spec Always constraint: "- The toast must be visible while the consent banner is up; the banner must remain visible AND clickable at all times — never cover its interactive (button) area, never dismiss or move it." Spec I/O matrix: "| Toast_during_consent | Fresh profile (no consent choice); any toast fires while banner is up | Toast visible (top-right); banner still visible + clickable; toast box does not intersect banner button area | If viewport is tiny and the customize panel makes the banner tall, toast may transiently overlap the banner's upper body-text region — never the bottom-aligned buttons; toast auto-dismisses in 5s |" README corner evidence: "{"toastY":{"top":80,"bottom":152},"buttons":{"consent-reject-all":{"top":9,"bottom":52}," "consent-customize":{"top":60,"bottom":103},"consent-accept-all":{"top":111,"bottom":154}," "consent-save":{"top":400,"bottom":443}}" followed by "The toast is still visible (`toastVisible:true`, z 2147483001) and transiently overlaps the \"Reject all\" / \"Customize\" / \"Accept all\" row for its 5s lifetime (the toast is dismissible via its ✕ and auto-dismisses)." and "The frozen spec's \"never the bottom-aligned buttons\" guarantee holds in every case where the buttons actually ARE bottom-aligned (any viewport the banner fits)."
detail: The acceptance criterion promises buttons never covered by the toast; the shipped corner evidence shows Customize (60-103) and Accept all (111-154) intersecting the toast (80-152) for 5s. The artifact reinterprets the frozen guarantee rather than meeting it.
recommended_fix: Either renegotiate the frozen constraint to name the tiny-viewport exception explicitly, or suppress/reposition toasts while an expanded consent panel overflows the viewport.

title: The conditional hint branch (viewed stop IS current -> title omitted) has no test pin
detail: Only hint presence is pinned (detail-page test with a non-viewed app). The deliberate !is_current suppression from the R1 change log is unverified; a regression rendering the title on the current stop passes the suite.
recommended_fix: Add a stepper test rendering a viewed-status application asserting the title attribute is absent on stepper-stop-viewed.

evidence:

+and transiently overlaps the "Reject all" / "Customize" / "Accept all" row for
